title: SvgPattern
responsibility: Renders the native pattern element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgPattern.attributes
inputs.description: Native pattern attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgPattern.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native pattern element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgPattern
outputs.description: The actual native pattern element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
